purpose: evidence-led spec expansion; this file stages no specs and fetches nothing

current_state.note: recomputed from audit/data-staging/vehicle_observations.jsonl at generation time; concentration is by source rather than placeholder/duplicate contamination

tiers.name: already-captured bytes (zero fetch)
tiers.action: parse with the same-record binding already required for prices (model card + spec cell + mutation tests); no new acquisition
tiers.why_highest_value: the figures exist in artifacts we already hold, so cost is extraction + tests only, and provenance is already sidecar-backed

tiers.name: official spec pages linked by captured documents
tiers.action: small, laddered acquisition of the linked URLs only, one brand per cycle, each earning its own artifact + sidecar + adapter gate
tiers.why_second: the link targets are published by the OEM pages we already fetched, so the structure is known to exist before any request is made

tiers.name: secondary media (AUTOMOTIVE_MEDIA / RESEARCH_UNVERIFIED)
tiers.action: only where an article's own scope proves the model, and only ever as secondary corroboration — never promoted to official, never a source of official spec values

registry_patterns: \d+ (?:แรงม้า|hp|PS) ... \d+ (?:Nm|นิวตันเมตร)

tiers.why_third: media figures are research-unverified by construction; they may only corroborate, so they cannot lead spec coverage

guardrails: no mass harvesting: one source per cycle, adapter only for real parseable structure
every spec row needs same-record model binding, a resolvable locator and a mutation test
placeholder-looking values are counted and reported, never promoted
spec expansion never blocks Phase 1 coverage work

route_safety.rule: a tier-2 target whose host is registry-blocked or a wrong target is planning-only until that brand's next_retry_at; this file makes no request
